## Featured research

Two studies built this month, both public at v0.1.0, both with a protocol frozen before any data was collected. Click a card to open the repository.

<a href="https://github.com/Agent007repo/trusttrace">
  <picture>
    <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="assets/trusttrace-dark.svg">
    <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)" srcset="assets/trusttrace-light.svg">
    <img src="assets/trusttrace-dark.svg" width="100%" alt="TrustTrace: 40 requirements, 15 decision records, 120 pilot generations, blinded matcher audit at kappa 0.73.">
  </picture>
</a>

<p align="center">
  <a href="https://github.com/Agent007repo/trusttrace"><b>Repository</b></a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <a href="https://github.com/Agent007repo/trusttrace/blob/main/paper/report.pdf">Report (PDF)</a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <a href="https://github.com/Agent007repo/trusttrace#results">Results</a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <a href="https://github.com/Agent007repo/trusttrace/blob/main/DEVIATIONS.md">Every deviation, dated</a>
</p>

> A typed metamodel links eight stakeholder roles to 40 requirements, decision records, components and executed tests. A feasibility pilot then asks whether small local models can extract obligations with exact evidence. Guided prompting looked better for Mistral-7B (0.86 to 0.91) but not for Qwen2.5-1.5B, and with 10 texts that is a direction to test, not a finding.

<br>

  <picture>
    <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="assets/continuumbench-dark.svg">
    <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)" srcset="assets/continuumbench-light.svg">
    <img src="assets/continuumbench-dark.svg" width="100%" alt="ContinuumBench: energy per request from 1.0 to 19.1 joules across six models; routing saved 23.8 percent live against a 29 percent estimate.">
  </picture>
</a>

<p align="center">
  <a href="https://github.com/Agent007repo/continuum-bench"><b>Repository</b></a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <a href="https://agent007repo.github.io/continuum-bench/explorer.html">Interactive explorer</a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <a href="https://github.com/Agent007repo/continuum-bench/blob/main/paper/report.pdf">Report (PDF)</a> &nbsp;·&nbsp;
  <a href="https://github.com/Agent007repo/continuum-bench/blob/main/DEVIATIONS.md">Every deviation, dated</a>
</p>

> Six quantised models on one Apple M1 Max, 450 questions in three domains, component power sampled every 200 ms. Model choice moved energy by about 19 times, "edge" was not automatically cheaper, and a routing cascade that looked like a 29% saving offline measured 23.8% live, below the 25% bar I set in advance. I report that as not supported.

<br>

## How I work

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="assets/principles-dark.svg">
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)" srcset="assets/principles-light.svg">
  <img src="assets/principles-dark.svg" width="100%" alt="Freeze the protocol, measure rather than estimate, audit the instrument, publish the limits.">
</picture>

Both studies were built with AI coding assistance, disclosed in each repository. I set the questions, wrote the gold labels, ran every measurement on my own machine and made the go or no-go calls. Every table and number in the reports is generated by code from committed raw data, and every reference is resolved by a script.
